items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: His name was Person, he played some guitar, years before that, and I'd go by the pool hall and study

ctx.x: And she's got some fella that plays nice tenor, Pierson or something?
Yeah and they're together all the time. I heard a recording that they did. It sounded good. She's really singin' her heart out, yes she is.
